svg.title: Here S = Πμ, and nl ± are the incoming and outgoing stationary response columns. The analytic contraction identities of S remove longitudinal columns. For l̸= 0, the remaining response columns each vanish to order two at p = 0; their product therefore has no degree-two coefficient. For l= 0, the primal and second-order stationary identities identify its contribution, through degree two, with μ2S(μp). The discrepancy vanishes to order three. Taking two momentum derivatives introduces another μ2, so the coefficient multiplier is L4μ2μ2 = 1. Consequently
